verdict.rationale: Customer.io documents an official MCP server that lets AI tools read workspace data, create and manage automations and one-time sends, and work with segments through natural language. Reads are separated from writes and deletes so each category can be approved independently, and a probe confirms the MCP get-started docs page exists. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of connecting an agent, documented connection/auth setup details (endpoint, transport, credentials).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: With the MCP server, you can do just about anything you can do in Customer.io via your AI tool of choice—read workspace data, create and manage automations and one-time sends, work with segments, and more—all through natural language prompts.
Reads are separated from writes and deletes... so you can approve each category independently.
